text:
anya: Anyone else seeing OkHttp calls hang on the emulator after a token refresh? Repro in our Android sample: app makes a request, gets 401, Authenticator does refresh, then subsequent calls just hang until the app is killed. :confused:

luis: Yea saw that yesterday on Pixel 3 emulator. Not consistent — sometimes just the first call after refresh hangs.

sam: Is your Authenticator calling the same OkHttpClient to fetch the token? That can deadlock because the client is blocked waiting on the call that triggered the auth.

anya: Yep — minimal Authenticator:```kotlin
class TokenAuthenticator : Authenticator {
  override fun authenticate(route: Route?, response: Response): Request? {
    synchronized(this) {
      // blocking refresh using the same client 
      val tokenResp = authClient.newCall(Request.Builder().url(tokenUrl).post(body).build()).execute()
      val newToken = tokenResp.body?.string() ?: return null
      return response.request.newBuilder()
        .header("Authorization", "Bearer $newToken")
        .build()
    }
  }
}
```

sarah-android: That's the classic trap — OkHttp's internal dispatcher has a limited thread pool. If the auth call uses the same dispatcher you can run out of threads and the original call can't finish. On device it's rarer but emulator networking + slow token endpoint makes it reproducible. :warning:

luis: Quick fix was to use a separate OkHttpClient for auth with its own Dispatcher:```kotlin
val authExecutor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
val authDispatcher = Dispatcher(authExecutor)
val authClient = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .dispatcher(authDispatcher)
  .connectTimeout(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
  .readTimeout(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
  .build()
```

sam: Alternatively make the authenticator async (return null and trigger refresh in an interceptor) but that's more invasive. Also setting `callTimeout`/`readTimeout` helps avoid infinite hangs.

anya: Reproduced with emulator API 30 and slow token stub. I'll push a tiny sample repro to https://git.redwood.dev/devex/android-auth-repro and add instructions.

dev-bot: CI build started for branch anya/auth-repro (job #1247) :gear:

sarah-android: For onboarding docs we should add a note: "Do not perform blocking auth refresh using the same OkHttpClient — use a dedicated client or async flow." Could add a sample in the SDK repo too.

luis: Filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/987 — "Android: OkHttp Authenticator can deadlock on emulator / cause hanging calls". Steps to reproduce, logs, and suggested workaround attached.

anya: TL;DR action items: 1) push repro sample (done), 2) add note to SDK onboarding + example with separate auth client, 3) update sample app CI to run on emulator API 30 to catch regressions.

sam: I'll take PR for the SDK sample. Also maybe add a tiny test that simulates a slow token endpoint to catch this in e2e.

anya: Thanks all — saved me a long debugging session. Will ping when PR is up. :raised_hands:
